data.title: 墨染希 · 草莓要放在最上面
data.description: 希站在咖啡馆操作台前，用小夹子把切好的草莓放上芭菲。她退后一点端详，又把杯子转向你：“这样看起来是不是更好？”
data.promptProse: Nozomi stands behind the cafe counter in her yellow striped waitress dress and white apron. With small serving tweezers she places a sliced strawberry on a parfait, angling the glass toward the viewer. Daylight from the cafe window lights the fruit and cream.
data.animaCaption: The serving tweezers hold one strawberry slice directly above the parfait glass.
data.action: 用小夹子把草莓片放上芭菲
